InvoiceGuard 2.0.0 brings comprehensive upgrades with AI-powered invoice compliance and Feishu integration:

- Introduced full-process AI workflows for invoice OCR, duplicate detection, authenticity verification, and compliance reporting.
- Added image, PDF, OFD, and XML invoice recognition with key field extraction.
- Enhanced AI duplicate-checking engine combining exact match, hash-based, and image similarity algorithms.
- Integrated official State Tax Administration validation (Pro version).
- Launched compliance report generation based on official format, with direct Feishu (Lark) document and Bitable synchronization (Pro version).
- Enabled scalable batch processing for high-volume invoice handling (Pro version).
